Passagers (10): The vehicle can carry up to 10 infantry models on board.
Passagers (7): The vehicle can carry up to 7 infantry models on board.
Artillerie: Indirect-fire weapon: it has a minimum and a maximum range and cannot hit a target that is too close.
Véhicule Large: Large vehicle: it takes more room on the table and has a harder time squeezing through narrow spots.
Résistant aux Dommages: The unit takes hits better than others and lasts longer under fire.
Chenillé: Tracked vehicle: comfortable on rough ground.
Semi-Chenillé: Half-track vehicle: a compromise between speed and rough-ground movement.
À Roues: Wheeled vehicle: fast on open ground, less comfortable on rough terrain.
Courageux: The unit is hard to scare: it resists fear and panic better.
Fanatique: The unit fights fiercely and does not back down easily, even when things go wrong.
Frénésie: The unit works itself into a combat frenzy that makes it more dangerous in melee.
Charge: The unit is especially dangerous when it charges into melee.
Première Frappe: The unit strikes before others when combat starts.
Lance-Fumée: The vehicle can launch smoke to hide from the enemy.
Vol: The unit moves by flying (jump pack, rotor…) and crosses obstacles more easily.
Jump: The unit can jump over some obstacles or across short distances.
Officier: Leader of the unit or army: it commands the others and supports them.
Escouade de Commandement: Squad that accompanies a leader and fills the command role in the list.
Véhicule de Commandement: Vehicle that serves as the army's command post.
Bannière: The squad carries a banner that serves as a rallying point for the troops.
Garde d'Acier: Very heavy armour: the unit is especially hard to take down.
Booster le Moteur: The vehicle can push its engine to go faster, at the risk of aiming worse.
Scout: Scout: the unit can set up further forward than others at the start of the game.
Raid: Fast assault vehicle, built to reach the enemy quickly.
Véhicule d'Assaut: Vehicle designed to bring its passengers close to the fight.
Observateur d'Artillerie: The unit can guide friendly artillery fire onto a target.
Expert : Arme: The unit masters its special weapons and uses them better than average.
Lunettes de Visée: Precision sights: the unit shoots more accurately at distant targets.
Espion: The unit can sneak in close to the enemy.
Rare: Rare unit: only a few can be found in an army.
Animal Sauvage: Wild creature: it follows its instincts and does not behave like disciplined troops.
Zombie: Undead creature: slow, hard to stop and fearless.
Grapple: Weapon that grabs the enemy to hold it in place.
Cutting: Cutting weapon, effective at slashing targets in melee.
Flame : Flamethrower: Flamethrower: it sprays flames over an area in front of it.
Flamme: Flame weapon: it hits an area rather than a single target.
Flame burst: Incendiary projectile that bursts into flames on the target.
Grenade: Explosive weapon, thrown or fired, that hits a small area.
Laser: Energy weapon: accurate fire, effective against armoured targets.
Laser pistol: Small laser sidearm for short-range shooting.
Phaser : Phaser SMG: Energy sub-machine gun: rapid short-range fire.
Salvo: Salvo: the weapon fires several shots at once.
Tesla Club : Tesla: Electric weapon: the discharge hits the target and may jump to its neighbours.
Filoguidé: Wire-guided missile: it can follow its target until impact.
Sniper rifle: Precision rifle: very accurate fire over long distances.
Assault Shield: Assault shield: it protects its bearer when advancing into melee.
Reload: Slow-reloading weapon: it cannot fire every turn.
Advanced Reactive fire: Advanced reactive fire: the weapon can return fire more effectively when the enemy approaches.
Destructeur Sonique: Sonic weapon: its waves hit several targets at once.
Black Ops: Specialist trained for covert strikes behind enemy lines.
Tactique Défensive: The unit is trained to hold its ground and fight from cover.
Stunned: Weapon that stuns its target and slows it down.
